content.comment_body: Hello, when using virtual inputs from an HMI, where are the status of these inputs and outputs shown on the [product_name]? Or are they not displayed at all?

For network inputs and outputs on the [product_name], there isn't a straightforward way to display them as standard digital inputs or outputs. If you want to view them on the device's screen, you'll need to implement your own custom display logic.
What I do is highlight the most important signals by showing a message on the main screen for quick reference, especially if I only need to monitor a couple of them.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report difficulties monitoring HMI-driven virtual inputs and outputs on the [product_name] display since there is no built-in way to see them directly as digital I/O. As a workaround, users create custom indicators or messages to monitor frequently used signals, pointing to a lack of transparent status visualization for HMI-controlled inputs and outputs.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want an easy and direct method to view the status of HMI-controlled virtual inputs and outputs on the device's I/O display, without needing extra programming or custom solutions.
